recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. If OO still wants the FHIR-45046 return stage codes on the current implementer-facing SupplyDelivery artifact, add return-dispatch and return-reception to HL7/oo-incubator input/resources/supplydelivery/codesystem-supplydelivery-stage.xml and rebuild that IG.
issue_request: FHIR-45046 was an Applied OO R6 change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for SupplyDelivery relevant-history support by adding a previousDelivery Reference(SupplyDelivery) extension and return dispatch/return reception SupplyDeliveryStage concepts, while moving dispatch/reception profile-binding changes to FHIR-45506.
initial_application: The extension portion was applied in the FHIR Extension Pack by commit 1df85443 and PR HL7/fhir-extensions#178. The stage-code portion appears in unmerged HL7/fhir branch commit babe1ac0e5, which added return-dispatch and return-reception to legacy source/supplydelivery/codesystem-supplydelivery-stage.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-45506 handled the profile-binding work split out from FHIR-45046 and resolved to workflow guidance rather than core dispatch/reception profiles. Later commit 3b38b80cf2 removed SupplyDelivery and SupplyRequest from active core fhir.ini metadata and changed current core pages to link to the HL7/oo-incubator IG. Current OO Incubator SupplyDelivery stage terminology still has only dispatch and reception.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The FHIR core checkout no longer owns active SupplyDelivery build input, while the approved previousDelivery extension is already maintained in the Extension Pack and the remaining stage-code update belongs in the active OO Incubator repository.

related_jiras.note: Received the dispatch/reception profile-binding work removed from FHIR-45046 and is already represented on the combined branch by an external-repo audit commit.
Established the stage-based SupplyDelivery approach that FHIR-45046 extended with return-stage concepts.
